DAMGHANI:v1p204/r7.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p204/r7.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p204/r7.claim: Rushd can mean sound management of property.
DAMGHANI:v1p204/r7.anchor: الرشد إصلاح المال قوله سبحانه في سورة النساء

BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r6.claim: Guardians should test minors before puberty by observing religious soundness and their ability to manage money well.
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r6.anchor: واختبروا أيها الأولياء والأوصياء من ليس من اليتامى بين السفه قبل البلوغ

BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r7.claim: For prospective traders, test competence by entrusting them with money for buying and selling.
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r7.anchor: فإن كانوا من أهل التجارة فبأن تعطوهم من المال ما يتصرفون فيه بيعا وابتياعا

BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r8.claim: For those managing estates and households, entrust suitable expenses to them to reveal their judgment.
BURSEVI:v2p133#2/r8.anchor: وإن كانوا ممن له ضياع وأهل وخدم فبأن تعطوا منه ما يصرفونه إلى نفقة عبيدهم وخدمهم

BURSEVI:v2p134/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r1.claim: Reaching marriage age means puberty, when a person becomes eligible for marriage.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r1.anchor: {حتى إذا بلغوا النكاح} بأن يحتلموا لأنهم يصلحون عنده للنكاح.

BURSEVI:v2p134/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r2.claim: The verb ānastum means that guardians have observed and ascertained maturity of judgment.

BURSEVI:v2p134/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r3.claim: Rushd requires religious soundness and the ability to manage assets without incapacity or waste.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r3.anchor: {منهم رشدا} صلاحا في دينهم واهتداء إلى وجوه التصرفات من غير عجز وتبذير

BURSEVI:v2p134/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r4.claim: Once puberty and sound judgment are established, transfer the orphan’s property without delay.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r4.anchor: {فادفعوا إليهم أموالهم} من غير تأخير عن حد البلوغ.

BURSEVI:v2p134/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r5.speaker: أبو يوسف ومحمد
BURSEVI:v2p134/r5.claim: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad infer that an adult who remains wasteful or incapable never receives the property.

BURSEVI:v2p134/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r6.speaker: أبو حنيفة
BURSEVI:v2p134/r6.claim: Abu Hanifa delays transfer until age twenty-five, seven years beyond the assumed age of puberty, then releases it even without observed prudence.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r6.anchor: وقال أبو حنيفة ينتظر إلى خمس وعشرين سنة لأن البلوغ بالسن ثماني عشرة

BURSEVI:v2p134/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r7.claim: The phrase forbids consuming the estate wrongfully and wastefully; it does not permit small unlawful consumption.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r7.anchor: وليس فيه إباحة القليل وتحريم الإسراف بل هو بيان أنه إسراف

BURSEVI:v2p134/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r8.claim: Guardians who hurry to spend fear that the orphans will mature, reclaim the estate, and restrict their spending.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r8.anchor: {وبدارا} أي مبادرين ومسارعين إلى إنفاقها مخافة {أن يكبروا}

BURSEVI:v2p134/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r9.claim: A wealthy guardian must abstain from the estate, content with personal provision to protect the orphan and its assets.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r9.anchor: {ومن كان غنيا} من الأولياء والأوصياء فليتنزه عن أكلها وليمتنع وليقنع بما آتاه الله

BURSEVI:v2p134/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r10.claim: Istiafaf is more emphatic than abstinence: the wealthy guardian should actively seek greater chastity.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r10.anchor: واستعفف أبلغ من عف كأنه يطلب زيادة العفة

BURSEVI:v2p134/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r11.claim: A poor guardian may take a customary lawful amount for necessary needs and fair compensation for work, showing a trustee’s service-based right.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r11.anchor: {فقيرا فليأكل بالمعروف} أي بما عرف في الشرع بقدر حاجته الضرورية وأجرة سعيه وخدمته

BURSEVI:v2p134/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r12.claim: Witnesses should attest that the heirs received the estate, protecting the guardian from suspicion and dispute and clearing responsibility.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r12.anchor: {فأشهدوا عليهم} بأنهم تسلموها وقبضوها وبرئت منها ذممكم

BURSEVI:v2p134/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r13.speaker: أصحابنا
BURSEVI:v2p134/r13.claim: The author’s Hanafi school does not make witnesses obligatory and accepts the guardian’s sworn statement of delivery.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r13.anchor: وإن لم يكن واجبا عند أصحابنا فإن الوصي مصدق في الدفع مع اليمين

BURSEVI:v2p134/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r14.speaker: مالك والشافعي
BURSEVI:v2p134/r14.claim: Malik and al-Shafiʿi require proof and do not accept a guardian’s claim of delivery without witnesses.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r14.anchor: وقال مالك والشافعي لا يصدق في دعواه إلا بالبينة

BURSEVI:v2p134/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r15.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r15.claim: God records and preserves deeds; especially avoid the grave sin of taking an orphan’s rights and seek forgiveness before the afterlife.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r15.anchor: {وكفى بالله} الباء صلة {حسيبا} محاسبا وحافظا لأعمال خلقه فلا تخالفوا ما أمرتم به

BURSEVI:v2p134/r16.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r16.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
BURSEVI:v2p134/r16.claim: The Prophet warns that a wronged person must be appeased before the Hereafter, when good deeds are transferred or the victim’s sins are imposed.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r16.anchor: من كانت عنده مظلمة لأخيه أو شيء فليتحلله منه اليوم من قبل أن لا يكون دينار ولا درهم

BURSEVI:v2p134/r17.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p134/r17.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p134/r17.claim: One who has repented from many wrongs but cannot find the victims should increase good deeds and keep some acts sincerely private, hoping for divine reconciliation.
BURSEVI:v2p134/r17.anchor: فليكثر من حسناته ليوم القصاص وليسر ببعض الحسنات بينه وبين الله بكمال الإخلاص

AKHFASH:v1p245/r5.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v1p245/r5.speaker: author
AKHFASH:v1p245/r5.claim: آنستم is lengthened in آنستم رشدا and آنستم نارا; أنست بالرجل and أنسا instead have a short initial alif.
AKHFASH:v1p245/r5.anchor: وتقول: "أنست بالرجل" "أنسا" فالف "أنست" مقصورة وألف "أنسا" مضمومة*. ويقال "أنسا".

AKHFASH:v1p245/r6.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v1p245/r6.speaker: author
AKHFASH:v1p245/r6.claim: إسرافا وبدارا أن يكبروا means consuming the orphans' property hastily before they grow up.
AKHFASH:v1p245/r6.anchor: وقال {إسرافا وبدارا أن يكبروا} يقول لا تأكلوها مبادرة أن يشبوا.

FARRA:v1p256/r5.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v1p256/r5.speaker: author
FARRA:v1p256/r5.claim: آنستم means found or recognized; ʿAbd Allāh's reading is أحستم.
FARRA:v1p256/r5.anchor: وفي قراءة عبد الله «فإن أحستم منهم رشدا»

FARRA:v1p256/r6.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v1p256/r6.speaker: author
FARRA:v1p256/r6.claim: فادفعوا إليهم أموالهم addresses the guardians and the orphans.
FARRA:v1p256/r6.anchor: فادفعوا إليهم أموالهم يعني الأوصياء واليتامى

FARRA:v1p256/r7.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v1p256/r7.speaker: author
FARRA:v1p256/r7.claim: وبدارا أن يكبروا is an accusative verbal noun meaning do not hasten to consume the property before they come of age.
FARRA:v1p256/r7.anchor: وقوله: وبدارا أن يكبروا (أن) في موضع نصب.

FARRA:v1p256/r8.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v1p256/r8.speaker: author
FARRA:v1p256/r8.claim: The poor guardian may eat بالمعروف as a loan.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r2.claim: بلغوا النكاح means reaching the age when they can marry women.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r2.anchor: بلغوا النكاح} أي: بلغوا أن ينكحوا النساء

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r3.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r3.claim: آنستم means you recognized or became certain; its root sense is seeing.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r4.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r4.claim: بِدارا أن يكبروا means consuming the assets hurriedly before the orphans grow up and reclaim them.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r5.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p120#2/r5.claim: A wealthy guardian should refrain from eating the property; a poor guardian may eat moderately without extravagance.

MAJAZ:v1p116/r6.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v1p116/r6.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v1p116/r6.claim: ابتلوا اليتامى means test the orphans.

MAJAZ:v1p116/r8.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v1p116/r8.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v1p116/r8.claim: وبدارا means taking the property hastily before the orphan reaches maturity and demonstrates sound judgment.

MAJAZ:v1p117/r1.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v1p117/r1.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v1p117/r1.claim: فليأكل بالمعروف means the guardian must not accumulate the property as capital; taʾaththul is acquiring a principal fortune, as in al-Aʿshā's poem.

MAJAZ:v1p117/r2.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v1p117/r2.speaker: الأعشى
MAJAZ:v1p117/r2.claim: Al-Aʿshā's verse witnesses the root أثلة for an established principal or foundation.
MAJAZ:v1p117/r2.anchor: قال الأعشى: ألست منتهيا عن نحت أثلتنا

NAHHAS:v1p437/r1.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p437/r1.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي
NAHHAS:v1p437/r1.claim: Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami reads رشدا; رشدا and رشد are verbal nouns of رشد, as is الرشاد.
NAHHAS:v1p437/r1.anchor: وقرأ أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي ( رشدا ) وهو مصدر رشد ورشد مصدر رشد وكذا الرشاد

NAHHAS:v1p437/r2.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p437/r2.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p437/r2.claim: إسرافا is either a purpose object or a verbal noun functioning circumstantially; بدارا is coordinated with it, and أن يكبروا is governed by بدار.
NAHHAS:v1p437/r2.anchor: ولا تأكلوها إسرافا ) مفعول من أجله وقد يكون مصدرا في موضع الحال ( وبدارا ) عطف عليه

NAHHAS:v1p437/r3.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p437/r3.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p437/r3.claim: If the guardian is wealthy, he should abstain; if poor, he may eat reasonably; witnessing follows handing over the orphans’ property.
NAHHAS:v1p437/r3.anchor: ومن كان فقيرا فليأكل بالمعروف فإذا دفعتم إليهم أموالهم فأشهدوا عليهم

NAHHAS:v1p437/r4.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p437/r4.speaker: الخليل وسيبويه
NAHHAS:v1p437/r4.claim: Al-Khalil and Sibawayh allow إذا as a conditional in poetry, where it requires a verbal answer, but not in prose because its following clause is settled.
NAHHAS:v1p437/r4.anchor: يجازى بإذا في الشعر لأنها تحتاج إلى جواب ولا يليها إلا الفعل

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r1.claim: Guardians test orphans when they reach puberty.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : وابتلوا اليتامى يعني اختبروا اليتامى عند الحلم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r2.speaker: مجاهد، الحسن، السدي
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r2.claim: Testing means testing the orphans' minds.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد وابتلوا اليتامى قال : عقولهم قال أبو محمد : وروى عن الحسن والسدي نحو ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r3.speaker: مقاتل بن حيان
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r3.claim: The address is to guardians and trustees, who must test the orphans.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r3.anchor: عن مقاتل بن حيان قوله : وابتلوا اليتامى يعني : الاولياء والاوصياء ، يقول : اختبروهم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r4.speaker: مجاهد، أبو مالك، سعيد بن جبير، السدي
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r4.claim: Reaching marriageable age means reaching puberty.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r4.anchor: عن مجاهد قوله : حتى اذا بلغوا النكاح يقول : الحلم - قال أبو محمد : وروى عن أبي مالك وسعيد بن جبير ، والسدي نحو ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r5.speaker: محمد بن قيس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r5.claim: An alternative sets marriageable age at fifteen.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r5.anchor: ذكر عن أبي معشر ، عن محمد بن قيس قوله : حتى اذا بلغوا النكاح قال : خمس عشرة .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس، سعيد بن جبير، مجاهد، أبو مالك
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r6.claim: Finding sound judgment means recognizing sound judgment in the orphan.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : فان انستم منهم رشدا قال : فان عرفتم منهم رشدا - قال أبو محمد : وروي عن سعيد بن جبير ومجاهد وابي مالك نحو ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r7.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r7.speaker: عكرمة عن ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r7.claim: Deliver the property when the orphan reaches puberty with intelligence and composure.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r7.anchor: عن عكرمة ، عن ابن عباس في قوله : فان انستم منهم رشدا قال : اذا ادرك اليتيم بحلم وعقل ووقار دفع اليه ماله .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r8.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r8.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r8.anchor: قال أبو محمد : وروى عن مجاهد : رشدا : عقلا .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r9.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r9.speaker: ابن عباس، الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r9.claim: Sound judgment includes upright conduct and good management of property.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p864#2/r9.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله فان انستم منهم رشدا قال : ان عرفتم رشدا في حالهم والاصلاح في اموالهم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r1.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r1.claim: Sound judgment is religious uprightness and protection of property.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r1.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير قوله : فان انستم منهم رشدا قال : صلاحا في دينهم وحفظا لاموالهم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r2.speaker: عبيدة بن عمرو عن محمد بن سيرين
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r2.claim: A sign of sound judgment is establishing prayer.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r2.anchor: عن محمد بن سيرين ، عن عبيدة بن عمرو قال : انستم منهم رشدا قال : اذا اقام الصلاة .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r3.speaker: ابن شبرمة
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r3.claim: One definition is a year after puberty.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r3.anchor: ابن شبرمة يعني في قوله : فان انستم منهم رشدا قال : سنة بعد الاحتلام .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r4.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r4.claim: Give the orphans their property once they have grown up.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r4.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير في قول الله تعالى فادفعوا اليهم اموالهم يعني : ادفعوا إلى اليتامى اموالهم اذا كبروا .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r5.claim: The prohibition concerns eating from the orphan's property extravagantly or hastily.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : ولا تاكلوها اسرافا وبدارا يعني : تاكل مال اليتيم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r6.speaker: سعيد بن جبير، مقاتل بن حيان
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r6.claim: Extravagance means consuming the estate without right.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r6.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير : ولا تاكلوها اسرافا يعني : في غير حق قال أبو محمد : وروى عن مقاتل بن حيان نحو ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r7.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r7.speaker: السدي
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r7.anchor: عن السدي : قوله : ولا تاكلوها اسرافا وبدارا قال : يسرف في الاكل .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r8.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r8.speaker: ابن عباس، سعيد بن جبير، السدي
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r8.claim: Haste means consuming the estate before the orphan grows and can claim it.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p866/r8.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : وبدارا يعني ، ياكل مال اليتيم ببادرة ، فعند ان يبلغ فيحول بينه وبين ماله .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r1.speaker: عائشة
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r1.claim: The command to abstain addresses the orphan's custodian.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r1.anchor: عن هشام ، عن أبيه ، عن عائشة : من كان غنيا قالت : نزلت في والي اليتيم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r2.speaker: سعيد بن جبير، السدي، الحكم
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r2.claim: The wealthy person is the trustee of the orphan's property.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r2.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير قوله : ومن كان غنيا يعني : الوصي .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r3.claim: A financially secure guardian needs none of the orphan's money.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس : ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف : فلا يحتاج إلى مال اليتيم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r4.speaker: يحيى بن سعيد، ربيعة
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r4.claim: Alternatively, a wealthy orphan receives maintenance according to his means and the guardian gets nothing.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r4.anchor: سالت يحيى بن سعيد وربيعة عن قول الله تعالى : ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف قالا : ذلك في اليتيم ان كان غنيا انفق عليه بقدر غناه ، ولم يكن للولي منه شيء .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r5.speaker: الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r5.claim: A wealthy guardian must abstain from taking anything from the orphans' property.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r5.anchor: عن الحسن في قول الله تعالى ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف قال : والي مال اليتيم ان كان غنيا فليستعفف ، ان ياكل من اموالهم شيئا .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r6.speaker: ابن عباس، أبو العالية، مجاهد، سعيد بن جبير، الحسن، النخعي، الحكم، مقاتل بن حيان، السدي
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r6.claim: A wealthy guardian should take nothing from the estate.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف قال : بغناه لا يصيب منه شيئا - قال أبو محمد : وروي عن أبي العالية ، ومجاهد ، وسعيد بن جبير ، والحسن ، والنخعي ، والحكم ، ومقاتل بن حيان ، والسدي نحو ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r7.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r7.speaker: عامر
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r7.claim: For a wealthy guardian, taking from the estate is as forbidden as carrion or blood.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p867/r7.anchor: عن عطاء بن السائب ، عن عامر في قوله : ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف قال : هو عليه كالميتة والدم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r1.speaker: عمر
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r1.claim: Umar connects abstaining from orphan wealth with seeking prosperity through marriage.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r1.anchor: عن إبراهيم بن محمد بن المنتشر قال : قال عمر : التمسوا الغنى في الباه ، قوله : ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r2.speaker: عائشة
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r2.claim: A poor guardian who cares for an orphan may take a reasonable amount.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r2.anchor: عن عائشة : ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف قالت : نزلت في ولي اليتيم الذي يقوم عليه ويصلحه اذا كان محتاجا ان ياكل منه .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r3.speaker: النبي ﷺ
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r3.claim: The Prophet permits a poor caretaker reasonable, non-excessive use when asked what he may take.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r3.anchor: عن عمرو بن شعيب ، عن أبيه ، عن جده قال : جاء رجل إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال : ان عندي يتيما له مال ، وليس عندي شيء ، فما اكل من ماله ؟ قال : بالمعروف غير مسرف .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r4.claim: One report limits the guardian's eating to three fingers.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r4.anchor: عن السدي ، عن عكرمة عن ابن عباس قوله : ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف قال : ياكل بالثلاث اصابع .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r5.speaker: الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r5.claim: A poor guardian serving the orphans may eat from the edges of their estate.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r5.anchor: عن الحسن : ومن كان فقيرا وهو يقوم لهم بما يصلحهم ، فلياكل من حواشي اموالهم واطرافه بالمعروف .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r6.speaker: عائشة، أبو العالية
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r6.claim: Another view allows eating in proportion to the work done for the orphan.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r6.anchor: عن عائشة قالت : انزلت هذه الاية في اليتيم ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف : بقدر قيامه عليه - قال أبو محمد : وروي عن أبي العالية نحو ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r7.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r7.speaker: ابن عباس، مجاهد، ميمون بن مهران، الحكم
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r7.claim: An alternative is for a poor guardian to live on his own means rather than use the orphan's wealth.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p868/r7.anchor: عن ابن عباس ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف قال : ياكل من ماله ، يقوت على نفسه حتى لا يحتاج إلى مال اليتيم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r1.speaker: ابن عباس، عبيدة، أبو العالية، أبو وائل، سعيد بن جبير، مجاهد، الضحاك، السدي
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r1.claim: One interpretation permits a poor guardian to borrow from the orphan's property.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : فلياكل بالمعروف يعني القرض -

IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r2.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r2.claim: A loan may cover basic sustenance; repay if solvent, but dying insolvent brings no sin, and this is the only exception.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r2.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير قوله : ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف يعني : في القرض قدر ما يبلغ قوتا ، فان ايسر رد عليه ، وان لم يوسر حتى يموت فلا اثم عليه ، ولم يرخص في اموال اليتامى في غير هذا .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r3.speaker: سعيد بن جبير، السدي، مجاهد، أبو وائل
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r3.claim: Another loan view says a dying guardian should seek release from the orphan or his guardian; if unable to repay, God may absolve him.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r3.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف قال : قرضا واذا حضرته الوفاة ولم يجد ما يؤدي فليستحله من اليتيم ، وان كان صغيرا فليستحله من وليه .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r4.speaker: إبراهيم
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r4.claim: A customary allowance is enough to satisfy hunger and cover nakedness, not fine linen clothing.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r4.anchor: عن إبراهيم قوله : فلياكل بالمعروف قال : ليس المعروف بلبس الكتان ، ولكن المعروف : ما سد الجوع

IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r5.speaker: إبراهيم، عطية، عطاء، عكرمة، الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r5.claim: A different view allows taking from the estate without repayment.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p869/r5.anchor: عن إبراهيم في قوله : ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف : من مال اليتيم ولا يقضي

IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r1.speaker: الشعبي
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r1.claim: The guardian may take only under necessity comparable to carrion and must repay it.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r1.anchor: عن الشعبي في قوله : فلياكل بالمعروف قال : لا ياكل منه الا ان يضطر اليه كما يضطر إلى الميتة ، وان اكل منه قضاه .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r2.speaker: يحيى بن سعيد، ربيعة
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r2.claim: Alternatively, a poor orphan may receive support according to his poverty, with nothing going to the guardian.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r2.anchor: سالت يحيى بن سعيد ، وربيعة عن قول الله : فلياكل بالمعروف قالا : ذلك في اليتيم ان كان فقيرا انفق عليه بقدر فقره ، ولم يكن للولي منه شيء .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r3.speaker: ابن أبي الزناد
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r3.claim: The allowance for a poor person applies specifically to Bedouins and their like.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r3.anchor: ابن أبي الزناد في هذه الاية : ومن كان فقيرا فلياكل بالمعروف قال : كان أبو الزناد يقول : انما كان ذلك في اهل البدو

IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r4.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r4.claim: The command to hand over property is addressed to trustees.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r4.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير في قوله : فاذا دفعتم اليهم يقول للاوصياء : فاذا دفعتم .

IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r5.claim: Trustees should deliver the orphan's property with witnesses, as God commanded.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : فاذا دفعتم اليهم اموالهم فاشهدوا عليهم يقول : اذا دفع إلى اليتيم

IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r6.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r6.claim: Trustees deliver the property when the orphans reach puberty.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p870/r6.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير في قول الله تعالى : فاذا دفعتم اليهم اموالهم يقول للاوصياء : اذا دفعتم إلى اليتامى

IBNABIHATIM:v3p871/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p871/r1.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNABIHATIM:v3p871/r1.claim: God is sufficient as witness and no witness is better between trustees and orphans.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p871/r1.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير قوله : وكفى بالله حسيبا يعني : شهيدا يعني : لا شاهد افضل من الله فيما بينكم وبينهم .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r1.claim: The command may connect to 4:5 as a culmination of its ban; if the earlier foolish are specifically orphans, repeating their name clarifies the rule and anticipates their hoped-for maturity.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r1.anchor: العدول عن الإضمار لزيادة الإيضاح والاهتمام بالحكم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r2.claim: If the earlier foolish include adults generally, as the author thinks more likely, this verse singles out orphans because puberty is a foreseeable time for change; adult folly has no predictable testing point.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r2.anchor: ما وجه تخصيص حكم الابتلاء والاستيناس باليتامى دون السفهاء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r3.claim: Alternatively, the command connects to 4:2 and explains how and when orphan property is delivered; the explicit noun is used because the antecedent is distant.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r3.anchor: لبعد ما بين المعاد والضمير ، لو عبر بالضمير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p237/r4.claim: Ibtala means testing; hatta introduces the endpoint, while its initial or prepositional use depends on what follows, and most grammarians treat hatta before idha as initial.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r1.speaker: ابن المواز عن مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r1.claim: Testing occurs after discernment but before puberty; the likely reason is that testing earlier risks wasting assets because a child's reason is incomplete.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r1.anchor: ووقت الابتلاء يكون بعد التمييز لا محالة ، وقبل البلوغ : قاله ابن المواز عن مالك

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r2.speaker: البغداديون من المالكية
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r2.claim: The Baghdadi Malikis instead place the testing before puberty.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r2.anchor: وقال البغداديون من المالكية : الابتلاء قبل البلوغ

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r3.claim: Reaching marriageable age means ordinary physical maturity that prompts marriage, not an early marriage arranged for incidental reasons.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r3.anchor: فهو البلوغ المتعارف الذي لا متأخر بعده

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r4.claim: The perception of sound judgment is a second condition; its clause and response answer idha, with fa explicitly marking the conditional relation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r4.anchor: جواب ( إذا ) ، ولذلك قرن بالفاء ليكون نصا في الجواب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r5.claim: The wording makes puberty the default endpoint of guardianship only when sound judgment is found, preventing guardians from keeping wards' property for their own benefit.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r5.anchor: وكل ذلك قطع لمعاذير الأوصياء من أن يمسكوا أموال محاجيرهم عندهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r6.claim: Both puberty and sound judgment must occur before property is delivered; their order of occurrence does not matter, the position of the Malikis and Imam al-Haramayn, which the author endorses.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r6.anchor: أن مجموعهما سبب لتسليم المال إلى المحجور ، فلا يكفي حصول أحدهما

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r7.speaker: ثعلب
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r7.claim: As transmitted by al-Zajjaji, Tha'lab held that the second condition in wording is first in occurrence; Ibn Malik and al-Baghawi among the Shafi'is also chose this view.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r7.anchor: ونسبه الزجاجي في كتاب ( الأذكار ) إلى ثعلب ، واختاره ابن مالك

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r8.speaker: القفال والقاضي الحسين والغزالي في الوجيز والإمام الرازي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r8.claim: These scholars held that the order of the conditions in speech determines their order in occurrence, applying it to suspended oaths, divorce, and emancipation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r8.anchor: ونسبه الشافعية إلى القفال ، والقاضي الحسين ، والغزالي في ( الوجيز )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r9.speaker: إمام الحرمين
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r9.claim: Imam al-Haramayn rejects any significance to ordering the conditions; the author agrees, noting possible effects in conditional oaths and emancipation or divorce, not in reports or rulings here.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p239/r9.anchor: وقال إمام الحرمين : لا معنى لاعتبار الترتيب ، وهو الحق

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r1.claim: Choosing anistum rather than alimtum suggests that property should be handed over as soon as the first sign of sound judgment is known, without delay.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r1.anchor: للإشارة إلى أنه إن حصل أول العلم برشدهم يدفع إليهم مالهم دون تراخ ولا مطل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r2.claim: Rushd has two synonymous vocalizations and means ordered rational conduct; here it specifically means protecting and managing property well, as in the earlier testing.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r2.anchor: وهما مترادفان وهو انتظام تصرف العقل ، وصدور الأفعال عن ذلك بانتظام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r3.speaker: الفقهاء
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r3.claim: Jurists assign delivery to the guardian, who is responsible for establishing the ward's sound management by entrusting the property.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r3.anchor: فقالوا : يتولى الوصي دفع مال محجوره عندما يأنس منه الرشد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r4.speaker: اللخمي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r4.claim: A guardian appointed by a father or judge should not be accepted as having certified the ward's maturity without investigation, given possible collusion and corruption.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r4.anchor: وقال اللخمي : من أقامه الأب والقاضي لا يقبل قوله بترشيد المحجور إلا بعد الكشف

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r5.speaker: ابن عطية
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r5.claim: Ibn Atiyya likewise calls for court confirmation of a ward's sound judgment because guardians may collude with an immature ward to secure their own release.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r5.anchor: وقال ابن عطية : والصواب في أوصياء زماننا أن لا يستغنى عن رفعهم إلى السلطان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r6.claim: Although this caution did not become general practice, notaries commend documenting maturity for a father's appointee; the sound view for a judge's appointee requires proof before the judge, as practiced.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r6.anchor: والأصح أنه لا يرشد محجوره إلا بعد ثبوت ذلك لدى القاضي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r7.claim: The address is to the community generally, implemented by the officials responsible for wards and guardians; that official is the judge.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r7.anchor: وعندي أن الخطاب في مثله لعموم الأمة ، ويتولى تنفيذه من إليه تنفيذ ذلك الباب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r8.claim: The verse's hatta indicates that testing and perceiving judgment precede puberty, the established school position; another view forbids giving any property for testing before puberty.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p242/r8.anchor: والآية ظاهرة في تقدم الابتلاء والاستيناس على البلوغ لمكان ( حتى ) المؤذنة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r1.claim: Property is withheld unless both maturity and sound judgment are present; the general Muslim scholarly consensus requires both.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r1.anchor: إذا لم يحصل الشرطان معا : البلوغ والرشد ، لا يدفع المال للمحجور

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r2.speaker: أبو حنيفة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r2.claim: Abu Hanifa releases a ward after seven years beyond puberty even without observed sound judgment; the author says this contradicts the conditional wording and the rationale for guardianship.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r2.anchor: إلا أبو حنيفة . قال : ينتظر سبع سنين بعد البلوغ فإن لم يؤنس منه الرشد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r3.claim: By analogy, a person who becomes foolish as an adult or loses reason through illness or old-age senility is also placed under guardianship because the cause persists; Abu Hanifa disagrees.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r3.anchor: ودلت الآية بحكم القياس على أن من طرأ عليه السفه وهو بالغ

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r4.speaker: أبو حنيفة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r4.claim: Abu Hanifa denies guardianship over an adult, contrary to the author's analogy from continuing incapacity.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r4.anchor: وخالف في ذلك أيضا أبو حنيفة . وقال : لا حجر على بالغ .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r5.claim: The ruling covers female and male orphans; a girl who reaches maturity with sound judgment receives her property.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r5.anchor: فالأنثى اليتيمة إذا بلغت رشيدة دفع مالها إليها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r6.claim: The indefinite rushdan denotes a type of sound judgment: here prudent financial management, distinct from political judgment or guidance to truth.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r6.anchor: والرشد في المال غير الرشد في سياسة الأمة ، وفي الدعوة إلى الحق

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r7.speaker: الجصاص
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r7.claim: Al-Jassas argues that the indefinite noun permits any kind of judgment, including mere reason, so sound financial management is unnecessary; the author rejects this as bad Arabic and a category error.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r7.anchor: فمن العجائب توهم الجصاص أن في تنكير ( رشدا ) دليلا لأبي حنيفة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r8.claim: The property is attributed to the orphans because their claim becomes firmly established once mature, when their disposal no longer threatens relatives' and the community's interests.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p243/r8.anchor: لأنها قوي اختصاصها بهم عندما صاروا رشداء فصار تصرفهم فيها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r1.claim: The prohibition reiterates the earlier ban in 4:2 and exposes guardians who hasten to consume wards' assets before the wards mature and can demand an accounting.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r1.anchor: وهو تأكيد للنهي عن أكل أموال اليتامى الذي تقدم في قوله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r2.claim: At revelation, assets were often livestock, dates, grain, and wool; guardians consumed them by lavishly spending on themselves and their households rather than hiding or transferring them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r2.anchor: فكان أكلها هو استهلاكها في منافع الأولياء وأهليهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r3.claim: Israf means excessive spending on pleasures; its accusative may be circumstantial or stand for an absolute object, and the point is to censure the manner of consumption, not limit the ban to lavish eating.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r3.anchor: فإن الإسراف الإفراط في الإنفاق والتوسع في شؤون اللذات

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r4.claim: Bidaran evokes a race between guardian and ward: the ward approaches maturity to claim the estate as the guardian rushes to consume it, leaving the ward to prove any remaining claim.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r4.anchor: كأن المحجور يسرع إلى البلوغ ليأخذ ماله ، والوصي يسرع إلى أكله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r5.claim: The phrase an yakbaru completes the verbal noun of racing; kabura with fatḥa means grow older, while kabura with ḍamma means become great, and kabura alayhi means become difficult.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244/r5.anchor: وأما كبر بضم الموحدة فهو إذا عظم في القدر ، ويقال : كبر عليه الأمر بضم الموحدة شق

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r1.claim: Permission for a poor guardian to eat customarily qualifies the general ban: a modest share supports the guardian so that earning a livelihood does not distract from managing the ward's assets.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r1.anchor: وهو تخصيص لعموم النهي عن أكل أموال اليتامى في الآيتين السابقتين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r2.claim: The customary allowance varies with the circumstances of guardian and ward, time, and place; a report in Abu Dawud supports this allowance.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r2.anchor: وفي لفظ المعروف ( حوالة على ما يناسب حال الوصي ويتيمه بحسب الأزمان والأماكن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r3.speaker: النبي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r3.claim: A man who said he was poor and owned nothing was told to take from his orphan ward's property without extravagance, haste, or accumulating wealth.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r3.anchor: أن رجلا أتى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال : ( إني فقير وليس لي شيء ) قال : ( كل من مال يتيمك

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r4.speaker: عائشة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r4.claim: A report in Sahih Muslim says the verse concerns a needy orphan's guardian eating from the estate in reasonable proportion.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r4.anchor: وفي ( صحيح مسلم ) عن عائشة : نزلت الآية في ولي اليتيم إذا كان محتاجا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r5.speaker: المالكية
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r5.claim: The Malikis set the guardian's customary allowance at the equivalent wage for comparable work.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r5.anchor: ولذلك قال المالكية : يأخذ الوصي بقدر أجرة مثله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r6.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب وابن عباس وأبو عبيدة وابن جبير والشعبي ومجاهد
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r6.claim: These authorities say the permission is only a loan; Umar compared himself to a guardian over public funds and would repay after becoming able.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r6.anchor: وقال عمر بن الخطاب ، وابن عباس ، وأبو عبيدة ، وابن جبير ، والشعبي ، ومجاهد : إن الله أذن في القرض لا غير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r7.speaker: عطاء وإبراهيم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r7.claim: Ata and Ibrahim hold that a guardian need not repay what he took if he later becomes solvent.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r7.anchor: وقال عطاء ، وإبراهيم : لا قضاء على الوصي إن أيسر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r8.speaker: الحسن والشعبي وابن عباس
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r8.claim: Another report permits a guardian to drink the ward's milk, eat fruit, treat a diseased camel, and repair its watering trough.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r8.anchor: إن معناه أن يشرب اللبن ويأكل من الثمر ويهنأ الجربي من إبله ويلوط الحوض

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r9.speaker: عكرمة وابن عباس والشعبي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r9.claim: They interpret the permission as applying only in dire necessity, like eating carrion; the author calls this the weakest view because the verse hinges on poverty and the ward's property, whereas necessity concerns any property.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r9.anchor: وقيل : إنما ذلك عند الاضطرار كأكل الميتة والخنزير : روي عن عكرمة ، وابن عباس ، والشعبي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r10.speaker: أبو حنيفة وصاحباه
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r10.claim: Abu Hanifa and his two companions allow taking only when traveling on the ward's business, and only for travel sustenance.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r10.anchor: وقال أبو حنيفة وصاحباه : لا يأخذ إلا إذا سافر من أجل اليتيم يأخذ قوته في السفر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r11.speaker: الجمهور
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r11.claim: The majority equate a judge-appointed guardian with a father's guardian; the author endorses this because the verse does not distinguish them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p244#2/r11.anchor: فقال الجمهور : هما سواء ، وهو الحق ، وليس في الآية تخصيص

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r1.claim: Whether a wealthy guardian may take equivalent wages depends on whether the command to abstain is obligatory or recommended: obligation forbids taking, while recommendation permits wages for actual service, not mere supervision.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r1.anchor: فمن قال للوجوب قال : لا يأكل الغني شيئا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r2.speaker: أبو يوسف ومجاهد وزيد بن أسلم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r2.claim: They hold that this verse is abrogated by the bans in 4:10 and 2:188; Abu Yusuf leaned toward that position.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r2.anchor: وإليه مال أبو يوسف ، وهو قول مجاهد ، وزيد بن أسلم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r3.speaker: ربيعة بن أبي عبد الرحمن
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r3.claim: Rabi'a reads rich and poor as the orphans, assigning each enough or customary support; the author finds this far-fetched because ista'fafa means to restrain oneself from asking.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r3.anchor: فقال ربيعة بن أبي عبد الرحمن : المراد فمن كان غنيا أي من اليتامى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r4.speaker: النخعي وابن عباس
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r4.claim: They say a wealthy guardian should live on his own means without excess from the ward's estate, while a poor guardian should limit personal spending rather than reach for it; al-Nahhas and al-Kiya approve.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r4.anchor: من كان من الأوصياء غنيا فليستعفف بماله ولا يتوسع بمال محجوره

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r5.claim: Witnessing delivery makes the amount clear, permits later recovery of assets found to have remained with the guardian, protects the guardian from later claims, and prevents disputes.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r5.anchor: وفيه براءة للأوصياء أيضا من دعاوي المحاجير من بعد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r6.claim: Witnessing may be recommended to protect the guardian's own right, or obligatory to prevent disputes and serve public order, like documenting debts in 2:282.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r6.anchor: نظير ما تقدم في قوله تعالى : { إذا تداينتم بدين إلى أجل مسمى فاكتبوه } ( البقرة : 282 )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r7.speaker: مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r7.claim: Malik does not accept a guardian's unsupported claim that he delivered the property; Ibn al-Faras says otherwise the command to document would be pointless because denial exposes the guardian to liability.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r7.anchor: فقد جعل الله الوصي غير مصدق في الدفع إلا ببينة عند مالك

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r8.speaker: الشافعي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r8.claim: Al-Fakhr transmits al-Shafi'i as agreeing with Malik; al-Fakhr argues for this from the apparent obligation of witnessing, an argument the author calls weak because liability and moral duty belong to distinct legal categories.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r8.anchor: ونقل الفخر عن الشافعي موافقة قول مالك ، إلا أن الفخر احتج بأن ظاهر الأمر للوجوب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r9.speaker: أبو حنيفة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r9.claim: Abu Hanifa considers the guardian credible on oath because he is an entrusted agent; a further view explains this by treating witnessing as recommended.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r9.anchor: وقال أبو حنيفة : هو مصدق بيمينه لأنه عده أمينا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v4p245/r10.claim: The closing description of God as a sufficient reckoner rounds off the directives as exhortations entrusted to God's oversight; hasib means one who reckons, and the prefixed ba intensifies the assertion.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r1.claim: The address is general, though its practical burden falls on guardians; testing means examining the orphans’ reason, judgment, and conduct when they reach puberty.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r1.anchor: هذه مخاطبة للجميع، والمعنى: يخلص التلبس بهذا الأمر للأوصياء، والابتلاء: الاختبار

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r2.claim: Reaching marriage means puberty through a wet dream, menstruation, or an equivalent sign; ānastum means you knew, sensed, and experienced their sound judgment.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r2.anchor: وبلغوا النكاح، معناه: بلغوا مبلغ الرجال بحلم وحيض أو ما يوازيه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r3.claim: A poetic line witnesses the lexical sense of ānastum as perceiving or sensing something.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r3.anchor: آنست نبأة وأفزعها القناص ... عصرا وقد دنا الإمساء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿud is reported to read ḥastum, with ḥāʾ and silent sīn, in place of ānastum.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ ابن مسعود- «حستم» - بالحاء وسكون السين على مثال فعلتم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r5.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن وأبو السمال وابن مسعود وعيسى الثقفي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r5.claim: They read rushdan with fatḥa on rāʾ and shīn; the meaning is unchanged.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r5.anchor: وقرأ أبو عبد الرحمن وأبو السمال وابن مسعود وعيسى الثقفي: «رشدا» بفتح الراء والشين والمعنى واحد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r6.speaker: مالك
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r6.claim: Malik requires both puberty and tested sound judgment before wealth is handed over; Abu Hanifa allows one condition unless foolishness is established.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r6.anchor:
ومالك رحمه الله يرى الشرطين:
البلوغ، والرشد المختبر، وحينئذ يدفع المال

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r7.claim: The author rejects analogy with contracts needing two conditions: puberty is the usual time of completed reason, not a stated condition; the conditional clause is tested judgment, marked by in.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r7.anchor: والتمثيل عندي في دفع المال بنوازل الشرطين غير صحيح، وذلك أن البلوغ لم تسقه الآية سياق الشرط

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r8.speaker: سيبويه والخليل
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r8.claim: Sibawayh permits idhā as a conditional in poetry only from necessity; al-Khalil rejects its conditional force because the event after it is expected to occur.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r8.anchor:
وأجاز سيبويه أن يجازى بها في الشعر، وقال: فعلوا ذلك
مضطرين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r9.speaker: الحسن وقتادة وابن عباس وابن القاسم ومالك
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r9.claim: Al-Hasan and Qatada define maturity as soundness in religion and reason; Ibn ʿAbbas and one view of Ibn al-Qasim say reason and financial management alone, while another Malik report includes religion.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p10#2/r9.anchor: وقال الحسن وقتادة: الرشد في العقل والدين، وقال ابن عباس: بل في العقل وتدبير المال لا غير

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r1.claim: Some require the guardian to establish maturity before a judge or act with judicial trust; others leave the assessment to the guardian alone. The author prefers court review in his own time because guardians may collude to declare an incapable ward sound.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r1.anchor: دفع الوصي المال إلى المحجور يفتقر إلى أن يرفعه إلى السلطان

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r2.claim: The prohibition bars guardians from consuming orphan wealth beyond what is lawfully permitted; isrāf is excess and saraf is spending in the wrong places.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r2.anchor: نهي من الله تعالى للأوصياء عن أكل أموال اليتامى بغير الواجب المباح لهم، والإسراف: الإفراط في الفعل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r3.claim: A line by Jarir uses saraf for missing the proper place of giving; the source text continues the quoted line across the chunk boundary.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r3.anchor: رف أي لا يخطئون مواضع العطاء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r4.speaker: ابن عباس وغيره
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r4.claim: Badāran means hastening the ward’s adulthood: a guardian consumes the estate before the ward matures and claims it; the phrase is construed as a verbal noun with an implicit fear also possible.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r4.anchor: وبدارا: معناه مبادرة كبرهم، أي إن الوصي يستغنم مال محجوره فيأكل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r5.claim: A wealthy guardian must abstain from the orphan’s wealth, while a poor guardian may consume from it in a fair way.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r5.anchor: فأمر الغني بالإمساك عن مال اليتيم، وأباح الله للوصي الفقير أن يأكل من مال يتيمه بالمعروف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r6.speaker: عمر وابن عباس وعبيدة وابن جبير والشعبي ومجاهد وأبو العالية
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r6.claim: They define the poor guardian’s customary consumption as a loan from the ward’s wealth, repaid when the guardian becomes solvent and limited to need.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r6.anchor: إن ذلك القرض أن يتسلف من مال يتيمه ويقضي إذا أيسر، ولا يتسلف أكثر من حاجته

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r7.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r7.claim: A report from ʿUmar compares the guardian to the steward of public funds: he abstains when wealthy, eats fairly when needy, and repays when able.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r7.anchor: إني نزلت من مال الله منزلة والي اليتيم، إن استغنيت استعففت، وإن احتجت أكلت بالمعروف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r8.speaker: إبراهيم وعطاء وغيرهما
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r8.claim: They say a poor guardian need not repay what he consumed fairly.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r8.anchor: وروي عن إبراهيم وعطاء وغيرهما أنه لا قضاء على الوصي الفقير فيما أكل بالمعروف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r9.speaker: الحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r9.claim: Al-Hasan calls it a gift from God: only enough food to sustain oneself may be eaten, and no clothing may be bought from it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r9.anchor: قال الحسن: هي طعمة من الله له، وذلك أن يأكل ما يقيمه أكلا بأطراف الأصابع

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r10.speaker: إبراهيم النخعي ومكحول
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r10.claim: They allow enough food to sustain the guardian and clothing to cover nakedness, but not linen or fine garments.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r10.anchor: وقال إبراهيم النخعي ومكحول: يأكل ما يقيمه ويكتسي ما يستر عورته

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r11.speaker: ابن عباس وأبو العالية والحسن والشعبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r11.claim: They limit customary consumption to modest food and drink connected to tending the ward’s orchard and produce.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r11.anchor: إنما يأكل الوصي بالمعروف إذا شرب من اللبن وأكل من الثمر بما يهنأ الجربى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r12.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r12.claim: Other jurists make fair consumption compensation proportionate to the guardian’s work; Hasan ibn Hayy distinguishes a father-appointed guardian, who may eat fairly, from a judge-appointed guardian, who may not.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r12.anchor: وقالت فرقة: المعروف أن يكون له أجر بقدر عمله وخدمته، وقال الحسن بن حي: إن كان وصي أب

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r13.speaker: ابن عباس والنخعي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r13.claim: They interpret the rule as requiring the guardian to live from his own wealth so he does not need to take from the orphan’s estate.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r13.anchor: وقال ابن عباس والنخعي: المراد أن يأكل الوصي بالمعروف من ماله حتى لا يحتاج إلى مال اليتيم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r14.speaker: ربيعة بن أبي عبد الرحمن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r14.claim: Rabiʿa applies the rich and poor distinction to the orphans themselves: the wealthy live on their own funds and the poor are supported economically.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r14.anchor: وقال ربيعة بن أبي عبد الرحمن: المراد اليتامى في الحالين، أي: من كان منهم غنيا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r15.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r15.claim: Witnessing the return of their property is an order of caution and diligence, and a basis for witnessing all deliveries when the prior withholding is known.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11/r15.anchor: أمر من الله بالتحرز والحزم، وهذا هو الأصل في الإشهاد في المدفوعات كلها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r1.speaker: عمر وابن جبيرة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r1.claim: They connect the witnessing to a poor guardian’s repayment of a loan when he becomes solvent; the wording is general and includes other handovers too.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r1.anchor:
وروى عمر بن الخطاب وابن جبيرة أن هذا هو دفع
ما يستقرضه الوصي الفقير إذا أيسر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r2.speaker: الطبري
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r2.claim: Al-Tabari takes ḥasīban as one who suffices, meaning God can replace witnesses; the author prefers the sense of Reckoner who counts and requites deeds, warning anyone who denies a right.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r2.anchor: والحسيب هنا المحسب، أي هو كاف من الشهود، هكذا قال الطبري، والأظهر حسيبا معناه: حاسبا أعمالكم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r3.claim: Some jurists treat witnessing the handover as obligatory; others recommend it as prudent precaution.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p11#2/r3.anchor: الإشهاد هاهنا فرض وقالت فرقة: هو ندب إلى الحزم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r1.speaker: مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r1.claim: The verse followed Rifaʿa’s death, when his young son Thabit’s guardian uncle asked the Prophet what he could take from the orphan’s property and when to hand it over.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r1.anchor: أن رجلا يقال له رفاعة مات وترك ولدا صغيرا يقال له ثابت فوليه عمه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r2.claim: The orphan’s trial is to test his judgment, according to Ibn ʿAbbas, al-Suddi, Sufyan, and Muqatil.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r2.anchor: أنهم يختبرون في عقولهم قاله ابن عباس والسدي وسفيان ومقاتل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r3.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r3.claim: Al-Hasan and Qatada say the trial tests both reason and religion; Mujahid is reported with either this or the reason-only view.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r3.anchor: يختبرون في عقولهم ودينهم قاله الحسن وقتادة وعن مجاهد

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r4.speaker: الثعلبي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r4.claim: Al-Thaʿlabi adds that the test concerns reason, religion, and safeguarding property; Qadi Abu Yaʿla says it occurs before puberty.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14/r4.anchor: في عقولهم ودينهم وحفظهم أموالهم ذكره الثعلبي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r1.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r1.claim: Ibn Qutayba explains “reach marriage” as becoming old enough to marry women; ānastum means you know or discern, originally “saw.”
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة أي بلغوا أن ينكحوا النساء

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r2.claim: Rushd is soundness in religion and care of property according to Ibn ʿAbbas and al-Hasan.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r2.anchor: الصلاح في الدين وحفظ المال قاله ابن عباس والحسن

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r3.claim: Another report from Ibn ʿAbbas and al-Suddi defines it as sound judgment and care of property.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r3.anchor: الصلاح في العقل وحفظ المال روي عن ابن عباس والسدي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r4.claim: Mujahid and al-Nakhaʿi define maturity as reason.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r5.speaker: السدي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r5.claim: A report from al-Suddi combines reason and religious soundness.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r5.anchor: العقل والصلاح في الدين روي عن السدي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r6.claim: Removal of an orphan’s legal restraint depends on both puberty and maturity; guardians must test them and deliver their property once maturity is clear.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r6.anchor: علق رفع الحجر عن اليتامى بأمرين بالبلوغ والرشد وأمر الأولياء باختبارهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r7.claim: Puberty has five indicators: wet dream, age fifteen, or pubic hair for either sex, and menstruation or pregnancy for women.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p14#2/r7.anchor: الاحتلام واستكمال خمس عشرة سنة والإنبات وشيئان يختصان بالنساء

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r1.claim: The prohibition addresses guardians: Ibn ʿAbbas says not to consume an orphan’s property without right, or hasten to consume it before the child grows up.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r1.anchor: خطاب للأولياء قال ابن عباس لا تأكلوها بغير حق وبدارا تبادرون أكل المال

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r2.claim: A wealthy guardian should refrain from using the orphan’s assets and live on his own wealth.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r2.anchor: ﴿ ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف ﴾ بماله عن مال اليتيم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r3.speaker: عمر
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r3.claim: One view allows a poor guardian to take an advance loan, reported from ʿUmar, Ibn ʿAbbas, Ibn Jubayr, and others.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r3.anchor: أنه الأخذ على وجه القرض وهذا مروي عن عمر وابن عباس وابن جبير

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r4.claim: Another view permits only enough for the guardian’s needs, without excess; it is reported from Ibn ʿAbbas, al-Hasan, ʿIkrima, and others.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r4.anchor: الأكل بمقدار الحاجة من غير إسراف وهذا مروي عن ابن عباس والحسن

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r5.claim: A third view lets the guardian take a customary wage for work done for the orphan, reported from Ibn ʿAbbas and ʿAʾisha.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r5.anchor: أنه الأخذ بقدر الأجرة إذا عمل لليتيم عملا روي عن ابن عباس وعائشة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r6.speaker: الشعبي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r6.claim: Al-Shaʿbi allows taking only when necessary, with repayment if the guardian later becomes solvent and no repayment if he does not.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r6.anchor: أنه الأخذ عند الضرورة فان أيسر قضاه وإن لم يوسر فهو في حل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r7.speaker: عمر
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r7.claim: The majority treat the allowance as operative: the wealthy may take nothing, while a poor guardian occupied with the orphan’s care may take enough by custom without excess.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r7.anchor: حكمها عندهم أن الغني ليس له أن يأكل من مال اليتيم شيئا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r8.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r8.claim: Some authorities say a guardian who later becomes solvent need not repay, since the amount is compensation for his service.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r8.anchor: أنه لا ضمان عليه بل يكون كالأجرة له على عمله وهو قول الحسن

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r9.speaker: عمر
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r9.claim: Others say repayment becomes due if the guardian later becomes solvent; Ibn ʿAbbas is reported on both sides.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r9.anchor: إذا أيسر وجب عليه القضاء روي عن عمر وغيره وعن ابن عباس أيضا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r10.claim: A minority says the permission was abrogated by 4:29, but the author says this report from Ibn ʿAbbas is unsound.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p16/r10.anchor: وهذا مروي عن ابن عباس ولا يصح

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r1.speaker: القاضي أبو يعلى
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r1.claim: Witnesses at delivery are a precaution, not an obligation; evidence protects the orphan from falsely denying receipt and the guardian from an oath if delivery is disputed.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r1.anchor: هذا على طريق الاحتياط لليتيم والولي وليس بواجب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas, al-Suddi, and Muqatil say hasīb means witness.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r2.anchor: أنه الشهيد قاله ابن عباس والسدي ومقاتل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r3.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r3.claim: Ibn Qutayba and al-Khattabi say hasīb means sufficient or enough, deriving it from “this sufficed me.”
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r3.anchor: أنه الكافي من قولك أحسبني هذا الشيء أي كفاني

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r4.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r4.claim: Ibn Qutayba and al-Khattabi also explain hasīb as reckoner/accountant, on the pattern of words for table-companion and drinker.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p17/r4.anchor: أنه المحاسب فيكون في مذهب جليس وأكيل وشريب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, al-Hasan, al-Suddi, and Muqatil ibn Hayyan say guardians should test the orphans before handing over their wealth.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس، ومجاهد، والحسن، والسدي، ومقاتل بن حيان: أي اختبروهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r2.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r2.claim: Mujahid glosses reaching marriageable age as reaching puberty.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r3.claim: Most scholars say a boy reaches puberty through a wet dream and emission of semen capable of producing a child.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r3.anchor: قال الجمهور من العلماء: البلوغ في الغلام تارة يكون بالحلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r4.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r4.claim: Ali quotes the Prophet: legal orphanhood ends at puberty, and a fast is not to be maintained in silence until night.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r4.anchor: عن أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه، قال: حفظت من رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "لا يتم بعد احتلام

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r5.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r5.claim: Aisha and other Companions report that legal responsibility is lifted from a child until puberty, a sleeper until waking, and an insane person until recovery; fifteen is also treated as adulthood from Ibn Umar's battle-age report, which Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz called the distinction between child and adult.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r5.anchor: عن عائشة وغيرها من الصحابة، رضي الله عنهم، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "رفع القلم عن ثلاثة: عن الصبي حتى يحتلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r6.speaker: عمر بن عبد العزيز
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r6.claim: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz treated Ibn Umar's admission to battle at fifteen, after rejection at fourteen, as the distinction between minor and adult.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r6.anchor: فقال أمير المؤمنين عمر بن عبد العزيز -لما بلغه هذا الحديث -إن هذا الفرق بين الصغير والكبير

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r7.speaker: ابن كثير
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r7.claim: Of three views on pubic hair as a sign of puberty, Ibn Kathir rejects distinguishing Muslim boys from protected non-Muslim boys and holds the sign applies to both because it is natural and artificial removal is unlikely.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r7.anchor: والصحيح أنها بلوغ في حق الجميع لأن هذا أمر جبلي يستوي فيه الناس

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r8.speaker: عطية القرظي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r8.claim: Atiyya al-Qurazi reports that captives of Qurayza were examined: those with pubic hair were killed, while those without it were released; he was among those released.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p215/r8.anchor: عن عطية القرظي، رضي الله عنه قال: عرضنا على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم قريظة فكان من أنبت قتل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r1.speaker: الترمذي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r1.claim: The Qurayza puberty report is transmitted in all four Sunan collections; al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih, reflecting Sa'd ibn Mu'adh's ruling to kill combatants and enslave their offspring.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r1.anchor: وقال الترمذي: حسن صحيح. وإنما كان كذلك؛ لأن سعد بن معاذ، رضي الله عنه، كان قد حكم فيهم بقتل المقاتلة وسبي الذرية.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r2.speaker: عمر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r2.claim: A report says Umar examined a boy accused of falsely claiming sexual relations with a girl, found no pubic hair, and dropped the penalty.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r2.anchor: عن عمر: أن غلاما ابتهر جارية في شعره، فقال عمر، رضي الله عنه: انظروا إليه.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r3.speaker: أبو عبيد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r3.claim: Abu Ubayd explains ibtihār as falsely claiming sex, while ibtiyār means the claim is true; al-Kumayt's verse witnesses the distinction between the two words.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r3.anchor: قال أبو عبيد: ابتهرها: أي قذفها، والابتهار (3) أن يقول: فعلت بها وهو كاذب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r4.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r4.claim: Sa'id ibn Jubayr, Ibn Abbas, al-Hasan, and other authorities explain discernment as sound religion and protection of wealth; jurists end guardianship when a boy reaches puberty with these qualities.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216/r4.anchor: قال سعيد بن جبير: يعني: صلاحا في دينهم وحفظا لأموالهم.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r1.claim: Guardians are forbidden to consume orphan property wastefully or hastily before the orphans reach adulthood, unless there is a necessary need.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r1.anchor: وقوله: {ولا تأكلوها إسرافا وبدارا أن يكبروا} ينهى تعالى عن أكل أموال اليتامى من غير حاجة ضرورية

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r2.speaker: الشعبي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r2.claim: Al-Sha'bi says a wealthy guardian must abstain from orphan property as from carrion and blood.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r2.anchor: قال الشعبي: هو عليه كالميتة والدم.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r3.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r3.claim: Aisha says the allowance concerns an orphan's guardian who manages and improves the estate and is needy; he may eat a customary amount proportionate to his work.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r3.anchor: عن عائشة قالت: أنزلت هذه الآية في والي اليتيم {ومن كان غنيا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r4.claim: Jurists cap a needy guardian's draw at the lesser of a fair wage for the work or the amount needed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r4.anchor: قال الفقهاء: له أن يأكل أقل الأمرين: أجرة مثله أو قدر حاجته.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r5.speaker: الشافعي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r5.claim: One view requires no repayment if the guardian later becomes solvent; al-Shafi'i's companions prefer it because the verse permits eating without requiring compensation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r5.anchor: وهذا هو الصحيح عند أصحاب الشافعي؛ لأن الآية أباحت الأكل من غير بدل.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r6.claim: A man without assets who has an orphan asks about using the orphan's wealth; the Prophet permits customary, non-wasteful use, without hoarding or shielding one's own property at the orphan's expense.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r6.anchor: عن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده: أن رجلا سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: ليس لي مال ولي يتيم؟

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r7.claim: A second version answers that a guardian with nothing may eat from the orphan's estate in customary measure, without excess.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p216#2/r7.anchor: عن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده قال: جاء رجل إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: إن عندي يتيما عنده مال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r1.claim: The second juristic position requires a guardian to repay what he consumed once solvent, treating the allowance as a necessary loan from property normally protected from use.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r1.anchor: والثاني: نعم؛ لأن مال اليتيم على الحظر، وإنما أبيح للحاجة، فيرد بدله كأكل مال الغير للمضطر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r2.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r2.claim: Umar says he treated himself like an orphan's guardian: he abstained when wealthy, borrowed from the public treasury when in need, and repaid after becoming solvent; Ibn Kathir calls al-Bara's chain authentic.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r2.anchor: عن حارثة بن مضرب قال: قال عمر [بن الخطاب] (9) رضي الله عنه: إني أنزلت نفسي من هذا المال بمنزلة والي اليتيم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets eating according to recognized fair measure as taking a loan from the orphan's wealth; Ubayda, Abu al-Aliya, Abu Wa'il, one report from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, Mujahid, al-Dahhak, and al-Suddi are also cited for this view.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {ومن كان فقيرا فليأكل بالمعروف} يعني: القرض.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r4.speaker: عطاء بن أبي رباح
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r4.claim: Ata ibn Abi Rabah, Ikrima, Ibrahim al-Nakha'i, Atiyya al-Awfi, and al-Hasan hold that the guardian need not repay the customary amount consumed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r4.anchor: وبهذا القول -وهو عدم أداء البدل (8) -يقول عطاء بن أبي رباح، وعكرمة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r5.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r5.claim: A second report from Umar tells al-Bara that a needy guardian may take from the public funds but must restore it when able, and abstain if self-sufficient.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p217/r5.anchor: عن البراء قال: قال لي عمر، رضي الله عنه: إني أنزلت نفسي من مال الله بمنزلة والي اليتيم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says a poor guardian may take from the estate for his own upkeep so he does not need to draw on the orphan's funds; Mujahid, Maymun ibn Mihran, and al-Hakam are also cited for this interpretation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس: {ومن كان فقيرا فليأكل بالمعروف} قال: يأكل من ماله، يقوت على يتيمه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r2.speaker: عامر الشعبي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r2.claim: Al-Sha'bi allows consumption only under dire need like eating carrion and requires repayment.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r2.anchor: وقال عامر الشعبي: لا يأكل منه إلا أن يضطر إليه، كما يضطر إلى [أكل] (4) الميتة، فإن أكل منه قضاه.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r3.speaker: يحيى بن سعيد الأنصاري
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r3.claim: Yahya ibn Sa'id and Rabi'a say the verse allows spending on the poor orphan according to his poverty, with nothing for the guardian; Ibn Kathir rejects this as distant from context, where rich and poor refer to guardians.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r3.anchor: قال: سألت يحيى بن سعيد الأنصاري وربيعة عن قول الله: {فليأكل بالمعروف} فقالا (5) ذلك في اليتيم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r4.claim: The linked rule is to approach orphan wealth only in the best manner until adulthood; a guardian in need may use it only fairly and for proper care.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218/r4.anchor: وهذا بعيد من السياق؛ لأنه قال: {ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف} يعني: من الأولياء

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.claim: After the orphan reaches puberty and discernment, the guardian must hand over the estate and have the recipient's receipt witnessed to prevent later denial.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.anchor: وقوله: {فإذا دفعتم إليهم أموالهم} يعني: بعد بلوغهم الحلم وإيناس الرشد [منهم] (7) فحينئذ سلموهم أموالهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r2.claim: God is sufficient as accountant, witness, and watcher over guardians, knowing whether they preserve the full estate or diminish it through concealed accounting and deception.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r2.anchor: أي: وكفى بالله محاسبا وشهيدا ورقيبا على الأولياء في حال نظرهم للأيتام، وحال تسليمهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r3.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r3.claim: The Prophet warns Abu Dharr, whom he considers weak, not to take command over two people or manage an orphan's property.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p218#2/r3.anchor: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "يا أبا ذر، إني أراك ضعيفا، وإني أحب لك ما أحب لنفسي، لا تأمرن على اثنين

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r1.claim: The common reading has rushd with ḍamma then sukūn; al-Sulamī reads both vowels open. They are two forms of a word meaning right guidance rather than error.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r1.anchor: قراءة العامة رشدا بضم الراء وسكون الشين، وقرأ السلمي بفتحهما

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r2.claim: ابتلاء means testing; nikāḥ can denote the marriage contract or intercourse; īnās is perceiving, seeing, hearing, or knowing, originally sensing what is familiar.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r2.anchor: الابتلاء: الاختبار، ابتلى يبتلي ابتلاء، والنكاح يعبر به عن العقد وعن الوطء.

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r3.claim: Isrāf is exceeding limits; badār is haste; ʿiffa is refraining from what is unlawful.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r3.anchor: والإسراف: مجاوزة الحد، ومنه السرف تجاوز الحد في التقصير

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r4.claim: إسرافا is parsed as a circumstantial accusative, object, or cognate accusative; بدارا is also a cognate accusative, warning against hastening before the orphan grows up.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r4.anchor: إسرافا نصب على الحال، وقيل: لأنه مفعول، وقيل: نصب على المصدر

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r5.claim: The verse was revealed about Thabit ibn Rifaʿa and his uncle: after Thabit's father died leaving a child, the uncle asked the Prophet what he could take and when to return the property.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r5.anchor: نزلت الآية في ثابت بن رفاعة وفي عمه، وذلك أن رفاعة توفي وترك ابنه وهو صغير

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس والسدي
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r6.claim: The guardian, executor, judge, or trusted agent should test orphans' intellect and capacity to manage their property.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r6.anchor: أي اختبروا وجربوا عقولهم وصلاحهم لمالهم عن ابن عباس والسدي

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r7.speaker: الحسن ومجاهد وقتادة وابن زيد
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r7.claim: They say guardians must test both reason and religion because frivolous conduct can lead an orphan to squander property.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r7.anchor: وقيل: اختبروا عقولهم ودينهم عن الحسن ومجاهد وقتادة وابن زيد

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r8.claim: ‘Until they reach marriage’ may mean puberty, as Ibn ʿAbbas, Mujahid, al-Suddi, and Ibn Zayd say, or reaching the age when marriage is needed and adulthood begins.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r8.anchor: قيل: الحلم عن ابن عباس ومجاهد والسدي وابن زيد، وتقديره: حتى إذا بلغوا حال النكاح

JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r9.claim: ‘If you perceive sound judgment’ may mean you recognize it; the first of three views defines it as soundness of reason and religion.
JISHUMI:v2p1458#2/r9.anchor: قيل: عرفتم عن ابن عباس، وقيل: أبصرتم منهم من اليتامى رشدا فيه ثلاثة أقوال
